annotations.summary: the api is spending its error budget 14x too fast
annotations.description: Over 7.2% of api requests failed with 5xx in the last hour and the last 5 minutes. At this rate the 30-day budget (0.5%) lasts two days.

model.expr: ((sum(histogram_count(rate(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[1h]))) / sum(histogram_count(rate(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1h])))) > (14.4 * 0.005) and (sum(histogram_count(rate(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[5m]))) / sum(histogram_count(rate(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])))) > (14.4 * 0.005) and sum(histogram_count(increase(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1h]))) >= 100) or vector(0)

annotations.summary: nearby search is spending its latency budget 14x too fast
annotations.description: Over 72% of successful nearby searches took longer than 300 ms in the last hour and the last 5 minutes. At this rate the 30-day budget (5% slow) lasts two days.

model.expr: ((1 - histogram_fraction(0, 0.3, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri="/api/places/nearby", status="200"}[1h])))) > (14.4 * 0.05) and (1 - histogram_fraction(0, 0.3, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri="/api/places/nearby", status="200"}[5m])))) > (14.4 * 0.05) and sum(histogram_count(increase(http_server_requests_seconds{job="placemap/api", uri="/api/places/nearby", status="200"}[1h]))) >= 100) or vector(0)
